question: Owner's words: 'update the calibration screen to have it calibrate the camera and the lidar use. Have it essentially do a bunch of poses that would be typically used in a dance setting. Importantly gather context from other projects on github ... Calibration will be a vital piece to this app so lets ensure its done right.' Research and plan this for Groove Coach, a SwiftUI iOS 17+ dance-coaching app scoring the dancer with MediaPipe 33-landmark pose (plus Apple Vision 3D) from the FRONT wide camera; test phone iPhone18,2 on iOS 26. Current calibration (docs/research/2026-11-18-calibration-research.md, CalibrationGate.swift): level phone, frame body, lighting advice, ~1 s T-pose captured into PoseClip.calibration_frames for bone lengths, lock. Questions: (1) which dance-relevant calibration poses/movements (e.g. arms up, side reach, squat/plie, turn to profile, step L/R, knee lift, arm circles) best calibrate bone lengths, joint range of motion, body depth/scale and per-joint confidence, and in what order and hold time; (2) depth: front TrueDepth vs rear LiDAR (AVCaptureDevice builtInLiDARDepthCamera, ARKit ARBodyTrackingConfiguration, sceneDepth) at 2-4 m dancing distance, accuracy, and whether to switch to the rear camera, fuse depth with MediaPipe, or use depth only for metric scale/floor plane; (3) camera calibration: intrinsics (AVCameraCalibrationData), lens distortion, FOV, exposure/white-balance lock; (4) what open-source GitHub projects (fitness, dance, mocap, ARKit body tracking, MediaPipe calibration) do, with repo links and file-level detail. Deliver a phased implementation plan mapped to the existing CalibrationGate step machine and CalibrationTuning, with test/verification approach via the existing Debug Link telemetry.

routing.note: Run the phased CalibrationGate and CalibrationTuning plan with Debug Link test steps only after these return; it depends on the depth choice. Also, the owner cites docs/research/2026-11-18-calibration-research.md, but the listed reports show none, so confirm that file exists before the plan relies on it.
